name: video-storyboard
description: Scene-aware video storyboard plugin & MCP server built on SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard (v0.7.6, Apache-2.0): summary vs lecture profiles, untruncated video_transcript for long courses, 1/1..1/8 DP grids, offline sherpa-onnx ASR, targeted OCR, video_clip, and video_cache_clean.
suggestedPrompts: Probe this video URL or local file first and summarize its duration and streams
Summarize this video with default preset (summary) and clean the cache afterward
Take complete lecture notes for a PDF using video_transcript, video_storyboard(preset="lecture"), and video_zoom
